evidence: We have described in previous reports that Ar + laser irradiation induces the selective decomposition of the alkylgallium adsorbed on an As-terminated surface but not on a Ga-terminated surface. The laser power density was estimated as the difference between intensities of the incident and the reflected beam. The growth rate with the IR laser irradiation reveals a similar tendency as the case of thermal epitaxy, and shifted toward low temperature region. The absorbed laser power density was estimated as the difference between intensities of the incident and the reflected beam. The growth rate with the IR laser irradiation reveals a similar tendency as the case of thermal epitaxy, and shifted toward low temperature region. It is expected from results of Rytz-Froidevaux et al. that the absorption band of TEG molecules chemisorbed on the polar natured surface becomes broader than that in the gas phase and shifted to low energy side.
